subject: Semaphore voucher request: short-term credits for POC throughput sweep
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan@semaphore.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Semaphore voucher request: short-term credits for POC throughput sweep

Hi Lauren / Monica —

Semaphore is asking for a short, one-week credit voucher so they can run a focused throughput/latency sweep against our hosted endpoints. Quick summary:

- Objective: validate p95 latency at 10k qps sustained per region for their reranking pipeline and compare cost/latency vs their on-prem baseline.
- Scope: 24h/day for 7 days, two regions (us-east, us-west), roughly 150k tokens/day peak (they estimate ~1.05M tokens total).
- Requested assistance: $5,000 equivalent credits (temporary quota uplift) + a single dedicated burst window during their east-coast evening to reduce cold-start variance.

I've attached their POC plan and the test matrix. Key asks for approvals: voucher amount and whether we want to require a signed addendum (they're open to a short MSA addendum).

Why I want to approve: this is a rapid buyer (engineering-led) with an active trial and high expansion potential; if latency looks good they plan a dedicated capacity trial in Q3.

Please confirm acceptance or any constraints (SLA, attribution, audit logs) and I'll loop Legal if needed.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachments: semaphore_poc_plan.pdf, throughput_test_matrix.xlsx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan@semaphore.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Semaphore voucher request: short-term credits for POC throughput sweep

Thanks for the write-up, Rishi. A few quick clarifying questions before I sign off: 

- Do they need Hosted (our standard endpoints) only, or will they want a Dedicated trial instance for the burst window?
- Can they confirm the exact test window(s) (start/end timestamps) so we can ensure monitoring retains logs for the period?
- Will they require enhanced retention/audit logs (security ask) during the trial? If yes, Legal/Security will want a short exception noted.

If this is strictly a hosted stress sweep and they accept normal retention, I'm inclined to approve the $5k voucher for the 7-day window. If they want a Dedicated burst or extended retention, we should route to Security and possibly do an addendum.

Looping Evan for the test window and retention notes.

-Lauren
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Park <evan@semaphore.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 11:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Semaphore voucher request: short-term credits for POC throughput sweep

Thanks, Rishi & Lauren — quick answers from our side: 

- Hosted endpoints are fine for the whole sweep; we do not need a Dedicated instance for this run.
- Proposed test windows (all EDT):
  * Warm-up: May 10, 02:00–04:00 EDT
  * Peak sweep: May 11, 19:00–23:00 EDT (primary)
  * Fallback/backfill: May 12, 01:00–03:00 EDT
- Retention: standard retention is sufficient. We do not require extended audit logs for this run.

We can sign a short addendum if Redwood requires it for billing/attribution; otherwise we are fine with a standard voucher process.

I'll also drop the final test matrix in the drive link and confirm the HubSpot deal id once you have it. Appreciate the quick help.

—Evan
Head of Platform — Semaphore Labs
ev an@semaphore.ai

- Constraints: hosted only, no extended retention requested.
- Attachments: semaphore_poc_plan.pdf (POC runbook), throughput_test_matrix.xlsx

Requested action for Billing:
1) Approve and issue a time-limited voucher that will automatically expire on 2027-05-18.
2) Apply temporary quota uplift scoped to the HubSpot deal id above and tag the voucher with attribution (campaign: SEMAPHORE-POC-MAY27).
3) Reply-all with the voucher code and console instructions so the customer can begin the sweep.

Evan — if you can confirm the HubSpot record link (or I'll create one), we can tag it for attribution.

Thanks,
